quests.title: Warm Coin, Cold Supper
quests.text: The coins you brought carry a broken circle with two hooks curling into the gap, and my drivers have seen it before, on the brigands who charge them tolls along the Causeway. The Coal-Purse Factors in the smoke-dark coats call themselves soot factors; the Causeway Brigands only collect for them while our carts stand idle. Defeat five Causeway Brigands or Coal-Purse Factors in all, by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}. Supper is getting cold while their purses stay warm.
quests.completion: The brigands collect the tolls, the soot factors handle the pay, and my drivers lose time to both. That tells me how the money travels, but not why it stays hot. Alna Archsight at Archshadow Post has runesmiths who can read the burn; I have an introduction for you.
quests.lesson: Forest kinds: brigands by day, wolves by night.

quests.title: A Stamp for Archsight
quests.text: Speak with Alna Archsight at Archshadow Post in Stormvault Heights about the brand on the convoy pay. Her runesmiths can read a stamp better than my drivers can describe one. Tell her Cinderline Watch still stands, and that the road now charges us in burnt coin as well as lost meals.
quests.completion: Toren has found the hands moving this coin; we still need to know what its mark does to the people paid with it. I will have the smiths compare a rubbing of the brand with the bones of the soldiers still collecting tolls. Stone and bone should give us two accounts that no clerk can tidy up.
quests.lesson: Handoff to the harder half of the Causeway.

quests.title: Nobody Left to Rally
quests.text: That stitching is a pledge: every soldier under the standard is borrowed against the next payment, and fresh wages keep them rallying to a war lost long ago. Defeat five Rubble Skeletons or Brandbound Collectors in all, after dark at the {name:front_shattered_line/breach}. Find {name:standard_bearer_ninepins}, {dir_from_giver:standard_bearer_ninepins}, and end his command as well. Report back to me, then seek the Warmaster's orders; I'd like the next thing our watch hears from that breach to be the wind.
quests.completion: Ninepins cannot rally that watch again tonight, but his command was one link in the payments, not their source. Take word to the Warmaster at Ashenward Bastion. He needs the enemy camp's own orders before deciding whether their seal tells the truth.
quests.lesson: Line climax: a named normal leader beside a night roster, toward Skyglass.

quests.title: A Posting at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}
quests.text: The Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord} needs fighters who know what a frontier posting costs. Report there, {dir_from_giver:pvp_fortress_accord}, for orders against the Throng camps on the Battlegrounds. If anyone asks why I sent you, tell them I prefer recommendations that can carry their own kit.
quests.lesson: Entry: from a 31-40 outpost to the PvP fortress at level 40.

quests.title: The Gate Does Not Salute
quests.text: The Quartermaster's latest requisition has four underlines and very little steel behind it. Bring me four Silversteel Bars for arrowheads and gate bolts. Our gate must hold when the Throng comes calling; looking imposing is a secondary duty.
quests.lesson: Fortress supplies: an ordinary tier-4 bar.

quests.title: Exhibits for the Drill Yard
quests.text: A recruit who has only fought straw tends to expect straw's standards of resistance. Bring me six War Trophies from Throng soldiers you defeat; any Throng garrison or guard post will do. We will put the enemy's kit beside the practice dummies and discuss the difference.
quests.lesson: War Trophies drop only from enemy guards killed by a player (never a player kill).

quests.title: Intelligence with Teeth
quests.text: My scouts are meant to count Throng tents, but lately their reports contain more teeth than canvas. Kill five Siegepack Hyenas by day on the {name:front_shattered_line/approaches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/approaches}. A scout should finish a report with both boots still occupied.
quests.lesson: Scouting a Battlegrounds zone: a kill quest on its 41-43 kind.

quests.title: Blind the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}, has been counting our patrols with an accuracy I find offensive. Defeat four Throng Pickets and {captain:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}, who commands them. Give our riders a chance to cross without becoming somebody else's morning report.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: A Gap at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}, watches every path our scouts would prefer to keep private. Kill four Throng Pickets and {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}, who is stationed there. A gap in their watch gives us room to work; keep your own guard up so we do not hand them one in return.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Dislodge the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}
quests.text: The troops at the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}, have had time to settle in and learn their ground. Defeat five Throng Regulars and {captain:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}, who commands that camp. Respect their preparation, check your own, and spare me the speech about how courage will cover the difference.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Rout the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, keeps the Throng's fighting strength on this front close at hand. Kill five Throng Regulars and {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high} there. You know the drill: pick your moment, finish the engagement, and count your wounds before you count your victories.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: No Cover for the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low}
quests.text: A forest offers plenty of cover, and the Throng is making better use of it than I would like. Raid the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low}, and defeat four Throng Skirmishers and {captain:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low} there. My scouts can handle roots and mist; give them fewer enemy sentries to worry about.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Pressure on the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}, gives the Throng a watch on ground our scouts need to cross. Kill four Throng Skirmishers and {captain:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}, who keeps that post. We need breathing room out there, and the enemy has declined to provide it on request.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Test the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high}
quests.text: At the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high}, the Throng has soldiers who know how to fight when the trees swallow every shouted order. Keep a steady hand and defeat five Throng Veterans and {captain:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high} in that camp. Settle on your plan before you go; I have yet to see a fern relay a command correctly.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Under Stonegrudge's Eye
quests.text: War Commander Stonegrudge now fights beside the garrison at the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}. Defeat five Throng Veterans and {captain:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high} in that camp, and take a party if you need one; the elite commander makes this a harder raid. A casualty caused by ignoring the briefing is still a casualty, however brave the report sounds.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).
